import MilneLib.Sheaf.EquivariantModuleSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebraModules
import MilneLib.Affine.GaloisStableSections

/-!
# Galois descent of native sheaf sections

The scalar actions on module sections are induced by the structure morphism.
Their scalar towers let a geometric linearization supply the semilinear module
input to Galois descent on any stable open.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

section Scalars

variable {K L : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (F : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)

/-- The coefficient action on sheaf sections induced by the structure map. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def moduleSectionsModule : Module K Γ(F, U) :=
  Module.compHom Γ(F, U) (sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U).hom

/-- Coefficients act through the native structure-sheaf section ring. -/
theorem moduleSections_isScalarTower :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
    IsScalarTower K Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  exact IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _

/-- Restricting scalars along section restriction agrees with the action
induced directly by the structure morphism on the smaller open. -/
theorem moduleSectionsRestriction_isScalarTower {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F V
    letI := ModuleLinearization.sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    IsScalarTower K Γ(X, U) Γ(F, V) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F V
  letI := ModuleLinearization.sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
  intro k m
  change ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
    ((sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U).hom k)) • m =
      (sectionsAlgebraMapHom p V).hom k • m
  exact congrArg (fun r : Γ(X, V) => r • m)
    (congrArg (fun f : CommRingCat.of K ⟶ Γ(X, V) => f.hom k)
      (sectionsAlgebraMapHom_naturality p hVU))

/-- Actual sheaf restriction is linear for coefficients from the base. -/
noncomputable def moduleSectionsRestrictionLinearMap {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F V
    Γ(F, U) →ₗ[K] Γ(F, V) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F V
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
  letI := ModuleLinearization.sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
  letI := moduleSectionsRestriction_isScalarTower p F U hVU
  exact (ModuleLinearization.sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU).restrictScalars K

@[simp]
theorem moduleSectionsRestrictionLinearMap_apply {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (m : Γ(F, U)) :
    moduleSectionsRestrictionLinearMap p F U hVU m =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m := rfl

variable (K L) in
/-- Successive affine bases give compatible actions on sheaf sections. -/
theorem moduleSections_isScalarTower_base [Algebra K L]
    (q : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :
    letI := moduleSectionsModule q F U
    letI := moduleSectionsModule
      (q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) F U
    IsScalarTower K L Γ(F, U) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra q U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra (q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L q U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule q F U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule
    (q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower q F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower
    (q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) F U
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
  intro k m
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul Γ(X, U),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K L Γ(X, U), IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

end Scalars

namespace ModuleLinearization

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} {act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {F : X.Modules} (D : ModuleLinearization act F)
  {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U)

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))

include hact

/-- A geometric linearization induces a semilinear action on native sections. -/
theorem isSemilinear_moduleSections :
    letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    GaloisDescent.IsSemilinear K L Γ(F, U) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
  exact GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.isSemilinear_of_smulDistribClass
    K L Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

/-- On a stable open, the actual sections are obtained by extending scalars
from their invariant module over the fixed section ring. -/
theorem moduleSectionsDescentMap_bijective :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
    Function.Bijective (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleDescentMap
      K L Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F U p
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
  exact GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleDescentMap_bijective
    K L Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)

/-- The native section descent comparison as a linear equivalence.  This packages
the bijectivity producer above in the form consumed by tensor and sheaf
transport, while retaining the actual section-restriction module on the source.
-/
noncomputable def moduleSectionsDescentEquiv := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F U p
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleDescentMap
      K L Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U))
    (moduleSectionsDescentMap_bijective p hact D hU)

@[simp]
theorem moduleSectionsDescentEquiv_tmul
    : letI := sectionsAlgebra pK U
      letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
      letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p U
      letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
      letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
      letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F U
      letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
      letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F U
      letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
      letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F U p
      letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
      letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
      ∀ (s : Γ(X, U))
        (m : GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.invariantModule
          K L Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)),
        moduleSectionsDescentEquiv p hact D hU (s ⊗ₜ m) = s • (m : Γ(F, U)) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hU
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F U p
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hU
  intro s m
  rfl

end ModuleLinearization

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
